# anthropic_spend_limit_increase_requests (Data Source)

Lists members' spend limit increase requests, most recent first (`GET /v1/organizations/spend_limit_increase_requests`). Requests from former members are excluded. Approving or denying a request is an action and is not managed by Terraform.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "anthropic_spend_limit_increase_requests" "pending" {
  statuses = ["pending"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `actor_ids` (List of String) Only return requests from these members (`user_...` IDs).
- `statuses` (List of String) Only return requests with these statuses: `pending`, `approved`, `denied`.

### Read-Only

- `requests` (Attributes List) Increase requests. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--requests))

<a id="nestedatt--requests"></a>
### Nested Schema for `requests`

Read-Only:

- `actor_id` (String) User ID (or scoped API key ID) that submitted the request.
- `actor_type` (String) `user_actor` or `scoped_api_key_actor`.
- `created_at` (String) RFC 3339 timestamp when the request was created.
- `id` (String) Request identifier.
- `period` (String) Spend limit period the request is for.
- `resolved_at` (String) RFC 3339 timestamp when the request was resolved. Null while pending.
- `resolved_by_id` (String) User ID (or scoped API key ID) that approved or denied the request. Null while pending.
- `status` (String) `pending`, `approved`, or `denied`.
